source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
How models cross each **terrain category**:

- Exposed/Light features: any model may pass through them, horizontally and vertically.
- Dense features, horizontally: **INFANTRY**, **BEASTS**, **SWARM** and **MOBILE** models.
- Dense features, vertically: **INFANTRY**, **BEASTS** and **SWARM** models.
- Dense features, any other model: horizontally only if every section its base would cross is no taller than 2"; otherwise it climbs up or down those sections, not through ceilings or floors, and must not finish that move on a surface above ground level.

While climbing, a model:

- stays within ½" of the feature horizontally
- adds the distance it climbs up and down to the rest of the distance it has moved during that move

Any model may be set up, or finish a move, at ground level within a feature. It may do so on a higher surface only if:

- it has at least one of the **INFANTRY**, **BEASTS**, **SWARM**, **FLY** or **MONSTER** keywords
- once there, it is stable with its base not hanging past that surface's outer edge at all

Examples:

- A **MONSTER** facing a dense feature whose sections are all taller than 2" cannot pass through it and goes around.
- **INFANTRY** walk through ruin walls.
- An **INFANTRY** model climbs and ends on a top surface it is stable on.
- A **VEHICLE** cannot pass through a dense feature but climbs up and down its sections over 2" without ending on top.
- An **INFANTRY** model crossing a **terrain area** without passing over or through any feature is not slowed.

A **MONSTER** may still climb dense sections taller than 2"; its example only shows that it may not pass through such a feature or finish its move on it.

interpretation.question: May a MONSTER climb dense sections taller than 2 inches?
